This '''species''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] distinguished by their [[Color/Legends|gray]] skin and tall heads with wide-set [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], some members of the species also sporting a series of small lobes extending from the back of their head, possibly consisting of [[Hair/Legends|hair]] or feathers. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], at least three members of this species, two adults and one child, boarded a transport headed for the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Phorliss]] alongside the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]].<ref name="MJ3" />

{{Species-stub}}

Stackpole]], and illustrated by [[Carlos Ezquerra]].<ref name="MJ3" />
